summary: Pinnacle Food Group filed a 6-K reporting results of its October 2, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting and concurrent Class B meeting, where shareholders approved raising Class B voting power from five to twenty votes per share and adopting amended articles. Holders of 39,537,425 voting shares (92.93% of entitled votes) were represented; Proposal 1 passed 39,530,383 for versus 6,542 against, with the Class B proposal unanimous at 7,695,000. The charter amendment will be filed with the Cayman Registrar within fifteen days. This is a routine governance and dual-class recapitalization matter, not a special situation.
